findings: Exactly two workflows in pinned tree: Docker Image Build and Docker Release. Build excludes app src-only changes via paths filter, comment promises other application test workflows absent from this tree. Neither read workflow runs model/path/group/application unit tests.

Image verifier accepts DEVICE=cuda128 with CUDA12.6 metadata and DEVICE=cuda with CUDA12.8, both device_available=False. It verifies broad CUDA wheel presence, not exact126/128 pairing or hardware/model functionality. Reproduced metadata adapters only.
Build matrix cpu/cuda/cuda128 on ubuntu-latest checks wheel suffixes and image sizes. CPU-smaller-than-CUDA assertion is packaging property, not matcher performance/quality parity.

Release builds/pushes CPU amd64+arm64, CUDA amd64, but has no test/verification steps or needs dependency on build-verification job. No model/device runtime gate in release source. No publication executed.

Both compose examples bind Immich photos read-only. Metadata merge validates write permission then attempts sidecar writes, so default mount cannot support merge without explicit configuration change. Qdrant depends_on does not wait for a healthcheck, so app db.init can race readiness; source observations.

Compose port mapping uses DEDUP_PORT while app envs uses same var, Docker HEALTHCHECK uses PORT baked at build; changing only compose DEDUP_PORT can leave healthcheck on old port. Source configuration mismatch, no container run.

Mutable latest image tags are defaults; Qdrant version pinned but dependency ranges/actions differ in provenance stability. Action pins are SHA references, base Python image tag not digest. No dependency tarball/image source qualification.

Public sample env files contain example credentials/placeholders, not read user environment. .env.example IsDev=False is nonempty string and earlier conf bool() makes native source dev flag true. Docker forces dev false.

Issue templates separate configuration/reproducible bugs and request reproduction/logs with sensitive values removed. PR template checkboxes are contributor statements, not executable test evidence; no issues/PR/comments created.
